subject: Supported ROM
text: The set expects the Super Mario RPG (U) [!].smc ROM, and the RetroAchievements menu "ROM Checksum" can verify a match.

evidence.quote: Super Mario RPG (U) [!].smc developer md5 is d0b68d68d9efc0558242f5476d1c5b81
You can check if your ROM matches correctly via "ROM Checksum" in the RetroAchievements menu.
